Information: Ph.D. Pharmaceutical Chemistry
Complete applications are reviewed for admission by the program as a group after the priority deadline.
Program Contact
Dr. Thomas Coombs
coombst@uncw.edu
Location/Delivery Method
Main Campus
Recommendations
3 letters of recommendation from individuals who are knowledgeable of the applicant's academic acumen and ability to complete the Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Chemistry.
Additional Requirements
Publications: Optional: Copies of publications.
Resume/CV: Yes
Personal Statement: A personal statement describing educational, professional and research experiences, career goals and reasons for pursuing the Ph.D. degree
Abstract: Optional: Abstract from the student’s master’s thesis research
Notes: Contact the program coordinator prior to application submission to determine your eligibility.
Notes: Students can enter the Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Chemistry program in the following three ways*:
1. Students with a M.S in Chemistry or other STEM-related discipline entering directly into the Ph.D. program, or
2. Students with a B.S. (based on a 4-year program) in Chemistry or other STEM-related discipline entering the MS in Pharmaceutical Chemistry and transitioning into the Ph.D. program, or
3. Students with a B.S. in Chemistry or other STEM-related discipline entering directly into the Ph.D. program.
Minimum requirements for students in categories 1 and 2
a. An overall grade point average of at least 3.0 out of 4.0 for the most recent degree earned.
Minimum requirements for students in category 3
a. An overall grade point average of at least 3.5 out of 4.0.
b. Evidence of independent research.
*Candidates admitted to our master’s program can apply for the Ph.D. program after 2 years with approval of the graduate committee and the thesis advisor.
